observations: Three photos show a vertical keyboard instrument with white and black keys, resembling a digital piano or keyboard.
The keyboard has a silver or light gray casing with black side panels.
Handwritten musical notes (treble clef and staff) are visible on the right side panel in all photos.
The keys appear to be standard piano-style keys, but the full length is not visible — only about 20–25 keys are shown across the photos.
The instrument is placed in a cluttered room with curtains, bedding, and a window with bars.
No brand or model name is visible on the instrument in any photo.
The seller claims it has 7 octaves and weighted keys, but no visual evidence confirms either claim.
The seller states the first 8 keys are not working perfectly — this is not visible in the photos, as no action or sound is shown.

claims.evidence: No visual or tactile evidence of key weight; cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
Only about 20–25 keys are visible; full keyboard length not shown. Cannot confirm octave count from photos.

claims.claim: The first 8 keys aren't working perfectly
claims.evidence: No visual or functional demonstration of key operation; photos show static keys only.

risks.risk: Keys may not be weighted as claimed
risks.proof: Close-up video or photo showing key resistance and mechanism, or a side view of the key action.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-weighted, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: Keyboard may have fewer than 7 octaves
risks.proof: Full-length photo or video showing all keys from top to bottom.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a shorter keyboard (e.g., 49-key or 61-key), which is less valuable than 7-octave (88-key).

risks.risk: First 8 keys may be non-functional or severely defective
risks.proof: Video showing each of the first 8 keys being pressed and responding (or not), with sound output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having non-working keys, which reduces value and may require repair or replacement.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or missing parts (e.g., power supply, stand, or internal components)
risks.proof: Photo of the back panel, power input, and any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete or potentially non-functional without accessories.

proof_requests: Full-length photo or video of the keyboard showing all keys from top to bottom.
Video showing the first 8 keys being pressed and responding (or not), with sound output.
Close-up of the key mechanism to verify if keys are weighted.
Photo of the back panel and any included accessories (power supply, stand, etc.).
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a keyboard, but critical claims (weighted keys, 7 octaves, functionality of first 8 keys) cannot be verified from current photos. Hidden risks related to functionality and completeness affect pricing. Proof is needed to determine the worst-case value and whether it can be priced.
